query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `skills` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `source` enum('clawdbot', 'composio', 'n8n', 'custom') NOT NULL,
  `skillId` varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `subcategory` varchar(100),
  `requirements` json,
  `config` json,
  `metadata` json,
  `isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `skills_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `client_skills` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `skillId` int NOT NULL,
  `isEnabled` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `config` json,
  `usageCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `lastUsedAt` timestamp,
  `activatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `client_skills_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`clientId`) REFERENCES `clients`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`skillId`) REFERENCES `skills`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
